verdict.rationale: Fern's docs mention 'search queries' analytics and a 'search-metadata' frontmatter for customizing/filtering search results, implying a built-in search index exists, and 'Ask Fern' offers AI-powered Q&A with citations as an alternative discovery path. However, there is no explicit claim or evidence about typo-tolerance, fuzzy matching, or relevance-ranking algorithm quality for a traditional full-text search box, nor independent hands-on verification of search speed/accuracy. Missing for 10: explicit typo-tolerant/fuzzy search documentation, relevance-ranking details, and independent corroboration of search UX quality.
